body.contents: A lifesteal SMP: kill a player and you take one of their hearts. Mobs, falls and lava cost you nothing. At 0 hearts you're out for 24 hours, then back with 3.
Claim your base with a golden shovel to keep it safe from griefing and theft; fights can still happen there. Spawn and the market are safe zones, and you have a few hours of protection to settle in.
The season ends in a finale for teams of up to four. You agreed to the short rules on the way in; the full rulebook is on the website.
